newsitem.title: USA: The top 10 movies at the U.S. weekend box office.
newsitem.headline: The top 10 movies at the U.S. weekend box office.

text.p: Following are the studios' estimates for the top 10 movies for the Feb. 14-17 Presidents Day holiday box office, according to Exhibitor Relations Co.
NOTE: Last weekend's figures in parenthesis.
"Star Wars" is released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp..
"Absolute Power," "Fools Rush In" and "Jerry Maguire" are released by Sony Corp..
"Dante's Peak" is released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd.
"Vegas Vacation" is released by Warner Bros., a unit of Time Warner Inc..
"That Darn Cat" is released by Walt Disney Co. "Scream" and "The English Patient" are released by Miramax Films, a unit of Disney.
"Shine" is released by Fine Line Features, a unit of Time Warner.
